46440.en: Let P be a point on the Euler line and A'B'C' the cevian triangle of P. Let Ra be the radical axis of the circumcircles of the triangles PBC' and PCB'. Define Rb, Rc cyclically. This ellipse is named here Hatzipolakis-Suppa ellipse. Its perspector is X_323 and its center X_46440
